rows.name: lowercase-haiku
rows.prompt: Write a haiku about rain. Use only lowercase letters.

rows.name: five-bullets
rows.prompt: List exactly 5 fruits as a markdown bullet list where every line starts with '* '. No other text.

rows.name: min-150-words
rows.prompt: Explain how vaccines work in at least 150 words.

rows.name: max-40-words
rows.prompt: Describe the moon in fewer than 40 words.

rows.name: no-commas
rows.prompt: Write a short paragraph about autumn without using any commas.

rows.name: quoted
rows.prompt: Wrap your entire response in double quotation marks. Tell me one fact about owls.

rows.name: json-object
rows.prompt: Respond only with a JSON object with keys "name" and "age" describing a fictional cat.

rows.name: end-phrase
rows.prompt: Give me three tips for better sleep. End your response with the exact phrase 'Is there anything else I can help with?'

rows.name: keywords
rows.prompt: Write a short story that includes the keywords 'galaxy' and 'teapot'.

rows.name: three-paragraphs
rows.prompt: Write about the ocean in exactly 3 paragraphs separated by the markdown divider ***.

rows.name: all-caps
rows.prompt: WRITE A SHORT MOTIVATIONAL MESSAGE IN ALL CAPITAL LETTERS.

rows.name: two-highlights
rows.prompt: Explain recursion. Highlight at least 2 sections with markdown, i.e. *highlighted section*.

rows.name: starts-with
rows.prompt: Start your response with the word 'Absolutely' and recommend a book.

rows.name: six-zs
rows.prompt: Write a tongue twister in which the letter 'z' appears at least 6 times.

rows.name: title-brackets
rows.prompt: Write a poem about friendship with a title wrapped in double angular brackets, i.e. <<title>>.

rows.name: two-names
rows.prompt: Give two different names for a coffee shop, separated by 6 asterisks ******. Nothing else.

rows.name: postscript
rows.prompt: Write a short note to a neighbour about a lost cat. At the end, add a postscript starting with P.S.

rows.name: forbidden-words
rows.prompt: Review a restaurant you imagine, without using the words 'good' or 'bad'.

rows.name: river-x3
rows.prompt: Use the word 'river' at least 3 times in a description of a valley.

rows.name: two-sentences
rows.prompt: Answer in exactly two sentences: why is the sky blue?
